dialogues.speaker: Borzyslaw
dialogues.text: Pah, I don't know what's so good about alcohol. I can't even sip a single drop of it... and that's why I've never been to The Flagship.

dialogues.speaker: Bedriskaya
dialogues.text: Well, different strokes for different folks, I guess. You can talk to Demyan — he's the bartender at The Flagship — and he'll serve you up an alcohol-free version of their Roulette Special.

dialogues.speaker: Borzyslaw
dialogues.text: Wait, so they have a secret menu? How'd you figure that out...?

dialogues.speaker: Bedriskaya
dialogues.text: We old gourmets have our ways, that's all. Oh, right, didn't you mention wanting to go to Piramida?

dialogues.speaker: Borzyslaw
dialogues.text: Oh, yes. It's giving me a bit of a headache, actually. What if I go there and can't find anything to eat...?

dialogues.speaker: Bedriskaya
dialogues.text: Don't be silly! When you get there, you have to try their "Fireside Merriment." I'm sure you'll be absolutely hooked. Oh, and don't miss out on their mushroom-stuffed rye sandwiches, either!
